messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED: GPU queue on private cluster 'acme-prod' (customer: Coraline Corp) has exceeded 95% backlog. Autoscaler reporting repeated failures: 'provision_failed: quota_exhausted'. Paging @maria_oncall @kevin_sre. Link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2141594321

maria_oncall: On it. paging phone now. seeing queue growth on the GPU request queue metrics, kernel hot path spiking.

kevin_sre: joining. quick question — is this a single AZ issue or cluster-wide?

maria_oncall: looks cluster-wide. kubectl to the private control plane is slow but i can pull the nodepool status.

maria_oncall: ```
# kubectl get nodes -o wide --context acme-prod
NAME                              STATUS   ROLES    AGE   VERSION
node-gpu-1                        Ready    gpu      3d    v1.25
node-gpu-2                        NotReady gpu      2h    v1.25
node-gpu-3                        Ready    gpu      4d    v1.25
```

maria_oncall: autoscaler logs show repeated failures to create instances: "API quota exceeded" and some timeouts to the onprem-provisioner.

kevin_sre: ok. two likely vectors: 1) customer cloud quota/limits hit (customer-managed), or 2) our private node provisioner is hitting rate limits / remote image pull bottleneck. Any recent config changes?

engineer-acme: (from customer thread) we haven't changed quota. we did push a larger model to the cluster earlier today which increased GPU allocation.

maria_oncall: noted. cs-rep, can you confirm with the customer whether there are cloud provider-side quota changes?

cs-rep: pinged their infra contact, awaiting confirmation. they say no quota change but they are seeing pending VM requests on their console.

dana_srelead: i'm going to triage root cause, mar ia keep me posted on mitigation. if autoscaler can't provision, we need to reduce inflight demand or route to fallback.

kevin_sre: mitigation options: 1) temporarily route Coraline traffic to hosted fallback (lower perf but keeps customers alive), 2) increase cluster max nodes if quota allows, 3) fail low-priority requests (batch jobs) to free slots. Which is fastest?

maria_oncall: hosted fallback is fastest. i can flip routing for their tenant in ~5m (console change + validation).

ops-bot: runbook step triggered by maria_oncall: "activate-hosted-fallback". executing playbook...

ops-bot: playbook step 1/4: create diversion rule for tenant coraline-corp -> hosted-api.

ops-bot: playbook step 2/4: update routing table and validate that auth tokens map correctly.

ops-bot: playbook step 3/4: warm up hosted pool with 2x baseline. warming...

maria_oncall: routing changed. i'm validating telemetry.

kevin_sre: while that's happening i'll try to push a manual scale for the onprem provisioner to see if we can force a few more nodes (may hit quota). running: `provisionerctl scale --cluster acme-prod --add 4`

kevin_sre: provisioner response: `error: quota_exhausted` and several 429s from image registry. looks like two issues: quota and registry throttling on image pull.

maria_oncall: telemetry shows queued requests drop ~70% after routing change. customer side reports some successful requests on hosted fallback.

engineer-acme: thanks, we're seeing lower tail latencies on our dashboard. can you keep hosted fallback on for now?

dana_srelead: yes keep it enabled until we have a durable fix. next steps: (A) confirm quota with customer & request quota increase if needed, (B) investigate image registry throttling and implement pre-pulled node images or cache, (C) post-incident rollout to avoid regressions.

kevin_sre: i'm collecting logs for provisioner and registry throttling window (last 2 hours). attaching snippet: ```
2026-03-15T20:02:01Z provisioner ERROR provision_failed quota_exhausted: requested 4, available 0
2026-03-15T20:02:03Z registry WARN pull_rate_limited scope=acme-prod repo=gpu-base: 429 Too Many Requests
```

maria_oncall: cs-rep confirmed customer sees pending VM requests with cloud provider and they have submitted quota increase request (support case #CC-98765). estimated 1-2 hours to approve.

cs-rep: customer also confirmed a large model push earlier, which saturated image pull burst, causing registry backoff. they're going to pause further pushes.

dana_srelead: mitigation summary: hosted fallback active (immediate), customer requested quota bump (in progress), we will add image pre-pull to node bootstrap in next patch (medium term).

maria_oncall: I'm going to page oncall rotation for a long handoff in 30m. leaving notes in the incident ticket.

deploy-bot: incident ticket INC-2141594321 created and assigned to dana_srelead; siege run to validate fallback completed OK.

dana_srelead: handing over to @kevin_sre for monitoring overnight. @maria_oncall please add any remaining logs to the ticket and create postmortem when stable. I'll coordinate customer comms with @cs-rep.

maria_oncall: ack. adding logs and timeline now.

kevin_sre: i'll monitor queue metrics, if we see new retry storms i'll throttle low-priority queues and notify.

engineer-acme: appreciated — thanks for the quick response. please keep us posted on quota timeline.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: hosted fallback active, tail latencies back within SLO for Coraline Corp. next update in 30m or on status change.

maria_oncall: closing my pager for now, handing to kevin. good job team :thumbsup:
